payload.body: ISSUE:0002 follow-ups for validation, both on main: faf3233 and a5f9b54. faf3233 takes your two notes. (a) update() reads the item back from the keychain locate() found, as an Item whose keychain is that path, not from the search list. No test can make a write land elsewhere without writing to the default keychain, so the ignored test covers the read-back only through the located path. (b) The test's comment now says update()'s own security -w read-back would prompt first, and that Always Allow could hide the fault; docs/releasing.md says to deny a dialog during that test. a5f9b54 is separate and older than ISSUE:0002. The auth and usage fixture servers accepted from a non-blocking listener; macOS gives the accepted socket that mode, and a read then ignores its timeout and fails with WouldBlock when the request has not arrived yet. It failed three auth renewal tests in one of my full cargo test runs (token renewal failed, network or TLS), and 30 further runs before the fix did not reproduce it. A new test, loopback::tests::accepted_streams_wait_for_a_late_request, pins the mechanism with a client that writes 100 ms after connecting: red on the extracted loop (WouldBlock, errno 35), green with set_nonblocking(false). Both fixtures now accept through loopback::accept_by. I cited ISSUE:0002 because the macOS CI its acceptance waits on runs these tests; the commit stands alone if hv wants it filed separately. At a5f9b54 all of these pass: cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test (34 unit, 21 CLI, 1 ignored), the ignored Keychain test, the release build, tests/release.sh, the signing tests, actionlint, intent critic rust on loopback.rs, auth.rs, usage.rs and lib.rs, and ARM64 Linux clippy; 30 of 30 lib-suite runs were clean after the fix. Logs, including loopback-red.log and loopback-green.log: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Ccusage/e1e5d4f2-40c1-4c02-8b5f-93719b6fc69d/scratchpad/issue-0002-followup/. Board: hold 3 is archived, since the live check is done and the renewal half is Acceptance 5's; hold 4 is archived, and ISSUE:0006 is claimed and in DOING.
